Port band lookup/detail, member identities and assignments, selected band profile, stats, per-song band scores and filtered song rows.

Duet/Trio/Quad controls respect selected band, shop/instrument settings and publication changes.
Selected player/band Suggestions adapt categories, instrument/global filters and virtualized incremental loads.

Selection, score-validity and Settings changes are reflected without stale cross-profile suggestions.
Use public shop data to render grid/list, new/leaving badges, availability and empty/offline/error states.
Hide/highlight settings alter Songs/Detail/Shop and preserve preferences through re-enable.

Port guarded Manual, licenses and approved profile export; keep operator-only service mutations out of the native client.
